items.title: Sri Lanka reach 404/4 as De Silva and Kusal Mendis hit centuries
items.summary: Sri Lanka moved to 404/4 at stumps on Day 3 of the first Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi, with Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Mendis scoring centuries before bad light brought play to an early close.

items.title: Container carrying Rs. 600 million worth of illegal cigarettes seized in Sedawatta
